function.arguments:
{"command":"python - <<'PY'
p='/work/rebuild.py';s=open(p).read();pos=s.index("sheet('变量与定义'");s=s[:pos]+'''alts=[]
for name,d in [('Bayesian',bayesian),('Diagnostic',diagnostic)]:
 eq=d.bank_equity.to_numpy();growth=eq[1:]/eq[:-1]-1;threshold=float(np.quantile(growth,.04));candidate=np.zeros(len(eq),dtype=int);candidate[1:]=(growth<=threshold).astype(int)
 spaced=candidate.copy();last=-100
 for i in np.flatnonzero(candidate):
  if i-last<=3:spaced[i]=0
  else:last=i
 ss=d.credit_spread.to_numpy()
 for tag,cc in [('原作者年度标签',d.crisis.to_numpy()),('权益年收益尾部4%原事件',candidate),('权益年收益尾部4%且事件间隔>3年',spaced)]:
  y=label(cc,3);valid=np.isfinite(y);f=ss<=np.median(ss[:-3]);diff=100*(y[valid&f].mean()-y[valid&~f].mean())
  alts.append([name,tag,threshold if tag!='原作者年度标签' else None,int(cc.sum()),int(y[valid].sum()),float(diff),'仅年度权益指标替代定义；原文另有月度权益事件定义，不可混同'])
sheet('事件定义敏感性',['模型','事件口径','权益年收益下4%阈值','事件总数','未来3年阳性窗','低利差风险差pp','边界'],alts)
''' +s[pos:];open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python /work/rebuild.py --input /input --output /work/output >/work/runlog.txt 2>&1; python - <<'PY'
from openpyxl import load_workbook
w=load_workbook('/work/output/模型验证证据.xlsx');print(w.sheetnames)
PY
cp /work/rebuild.py /work/output/rebuild.py"}

tools.description: Execute a shell command in an isolated Linux environment. Original files are read-only at /input and /app/input_files; persistent writable workspace is /work. Commands have a 120 second limit. Read actual files, make native Office artifacts, and inspect execution results.
tools.name: execute

tools.description: Write UTF-8 text/code into a relative path inside /work. Use Python Office libraries to generate actual Office files.
tools.name: write_text
